[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-2v[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]`:` Task Link Picker for bob capture and Bob Mac Capture[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Typing `:` at the start of any capture item, including any item of [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]a blank-line-separated batch draft, opens a fast, beautiful fuzzy [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]picker over every open (not done or canceled) task in the vault's [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]area and project notes. Accepting a task replaces the `:` query [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with the canonical `@route:block-id` link. Tasks without a block ID[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]get one first, from a prefilled suggestion. The link can then be [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]captured as-is or started with `=`, so any task can be linked into [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]today's Pomodoros in a few keystrokes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/task_link_picker.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Vault-wide linkable-task discovery and fuzzy ranking[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]discovery[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]discovery: add the read-only `capture_link_tasks` scanner. It collects [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Ready, Blocked, Next, and In Progress tasks from area, project, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inbox notes. It adds groups, the canonical order, ledger annotation, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]block-ID suggestions, schedule pull-forward flags, and a deterministic [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tiered fuzzy ranker, all with unit tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]`:` picker-query grammar in capture, capture-parse, and [/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]completion fields[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]grammar[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]grammar: add one claim predicate for single-token `:` items. Execution [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rejects them with teaching errors T1 and T2. capture-parse reports [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`incomplete` with `needs: ["task_link"]`. The completion field [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](`task_link` context) covers the sigil. Also update help text and add a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]claim-equivalence test.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]CaptureCore task-link picker index, source, and decoding[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac_core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac_core: in bob-mac-capture's CaptureCore, decode the new candidate [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fields and add the `taskLink` picker source and need. Add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`TaskLinkPickerIndex` with grouped and fuzzy-filtered presentations, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rows keyed by route and ref, and a `:`-aware FuzzyQuery. Cover it with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unit tests and verify on macOS CI.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]`task_link` completion candidates, round-trip tests, and docs[/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]complete[dim] · [dim][/dim]after discovery, grammar[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]complete: wire discovery into the `task_link` context of `bob [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]capture-complete`, with a pinned JSON schema, human rows, and help. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Prove accept-then-capture round trips (including capture-task-id for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tasks without an ID), check real-vault latency, and document the feature[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in docs/capture.md and README.md.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture task-link picker panel, ID prompt, and keys[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac_panel[dim] · [dim][/dim]after complete, mac_core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac_panel: route the `task_link` context into the picker card. Accept [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inserts `@route:id`, Shift-Return inserts it with `=`, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Command-Return inserts it and captures. Tasks without an ID open a [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]prefilled Add block ID prompt that assigns the ID and splices the link, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and Escape returns to the picker. Also update the views, README, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]real-bob fixtures, and tests, and get macOS CI green.[/#D7D7AF]
